name: BoxScore (DCT)
description: Measure how well a box abstracts an input object

inputs.name: Factor
inputs.description: Multiplier applied to the score (default 100: the score reads as a percentage)

name: FeatureVector (DCT)
description: Create a feature vector for an object

name: HarmonicAnalysisComplex (DCT)
description: Fourier shape descriptor of a complex signature (e.g. ComplexSignature): the radius of each harmonic in model units, independent of sample count, ordered |c1|, |c-1|, |c2|, |c-2|, ... N samples give N-1 values.

inputs.name: Signature
inputs.description: Shape signature as a list of complex numbers (u + iv per sample)

inputs.name: FVLength
inputs.description: Number of values to keep (lowest frequencies first). Default: all

inputs.name: Normalize
inputs.description: Divide by |c1| (the radius of the best-fitting circle), so the descriptor ignores size; the first value is then 1

outputs.name: HarmonicFeatureVector
outputs.description: |c1|, |c-1|, |c2|, |c-2|, ... after orienting the samples counter-clockwise. Invariant to position, rotation, start point, direction and mirroring; to scale only with Normalize.

name: HarmonicAnalysisReal (DCT)
description: Fourier shape descriptor of a real-valued signature (e.g. DistanceSignature): the amplitude of harmonics 1, 2, 3, ... in model units, independent of sample count. N samples give N/2 harmonics.

inputs.name: Signature
inputs.description: Shape signature as a list of real-valued numbers

inputs.name: FVLength
inputs.description: Number of harmonics to keep (lowest first). Default: all

inputs.name: Normalize
inputs.description: Divide by the mean of the signature (for DistanceSignature: the mean radius), so the descriptor ignores size

outputs.name: HarmonicFeatureVector
outputs.description: Amplitudes A1, A2, ... of r(t) = A0 + Σ Ak·cos(k·t + φk). Invariant to start point, direction, rotation and mirroring; to scale only with Normalize.

name: LineScore (DCT)
description: Measure how well a line abstracts an input object

inputs.name: Factor
inputs.description: Multiplier applied to the score (default 100: the score reads as a percentage)

name: PlaneScore (DCT)
description: Measure how well a plane abstracts an input object

inputs.name: Factor
inputs.description: Multiplier applied to the score (default 100: the score reads as a percentage)

name: RadialSignature (DCT)
description: Perform a radial signature analysis on a curve.

inputs.name: NumSamples
inputs.description: Number of radial samples to take

inputs.name: Plane
inputs.description: Analysis plane. If not supplied, auto-fit will occur

outputs.name: ComplexSignature
outputs.description: Curve signature where planar coordinates [u, v] is converted to complex number u + iv

outputs.name: DistanceSignature
outputs.description: Distance from the curve centroid to each sample point, measured in the plane (= |ComplexSignature|)

outputs.name: Rays
outputs.description: Rays from the centroid to each projected sample point

name: SphereScore (DCT)
description: Measure how well a sphere abstracts an input object

inputs.name: Factor
inputs.description: Multiplier applied to the score (default 100: the score reads as a percentage)

name: AsymmEuclideanDistance (DCT)
description: Generate a distance matrix of asymmetric Euclidean distances between two feature vector sets

inputs.name: Power1
inputs.description: Power of the distance when the supply is at least as large as the demand in every feature

inputs.name: Power2
inputs.description: Power of the distance when the supply is smaller than the demand in any feature (penalty: use Power2 > Power1 with distances > 1)

outputs.name: DistanceMatrix
outputs.description: Distance matrix data where row[i,j] is cost from demand[i] to supply[j]

name: EuclideanDistance (DCT)
description: Generate a distance matrix of Euclidean distances between two feature vector sets

outputs.name: DistanceMatrix
outputs.description: Distance matrix data where row[i,j] is cost from demand[i] to supply[j]

name: FrechetDistance (DCT)
description: Compute the Frechet distance between two curves

inputs.name: Sample count
inputs.description: Number of segments each curve is divided into (closed curves give N points, open curves N + 1)

outputs.name: FrechetDistance
outputs.description: Frechet distance between the two curves

name: HausdorffDistanceCurve (DCT)
description: Compute the Hausdorff distance between two curves

inputs.name: Sample count
inputs.description: Number of segments each curve is divided into (closed curves give N points, open curves N + 1)

outputs.name: HausdorffDistanceCurve
outputs.description: Hausdorff distance between the two curves (symmetric: the larger of the two directed distances)

name: HausdorffDistancePoints (DCT)
description: Compute the Hausdorff distance between two sets of points

outputs.name: HausdorffDistancePoints
outputs.description: Hausdorff distance between the two sets of points (symmetric: the larger of the two directed distances)

name: ManhattanDistance (DCT)
description: Generate a distance matrix of manhattan distances between two feature vector sets

outputs.name: DistanceMatrix
outputs.description: Distance matrix data where row[i,j] is cost from demand[i] to supply[j]

name: AlignToObject (DCT)
description: Align an object to another

name: Match (DCT)
description: Perform linear assignment of supply to demand using the Jonker-Volgenant algorithm

inputs.name: DistanceMatrix
inputs.description: Distance matrix as tree: one branch per demand item, each with one cost per supply item

inputs.name: AutoRun
inputs.description: Automatically run the algorithm. Set to false when working with large parametric problems so that you can manually perform the assignment between parameter changes. I.e., add a button here.

outputs.name: Assignment
outputs.description: Assignment indices. A[i] = j: assign inventory element j to demand element i

name: MatchLines (DCT)
description: Get the lines that connect supply-demand assignments

inputs.name: DemandPoints
inputs.description: Points that represent the demand elements

inputs.name: SupplyPoints
inputs.description: Points that represent the inventory elements
